$comment: BLENDER-ASSET-PIPELINE-1 manifest schema v1.0 (documentation form — batch_driver.py validates in code, no jsonschema dependency). Relative paths resolve against the manifest's directory.
blender_exe: OPTIONAL string — explicit blender.exe; else BLENDER_EXECUTABLE env, known installs, PATH
work_dir: OPTIONAL string — intermediate dir (default '_work' next to manifest)
deploy_tgl_dir: OPTIONAL string — deploy-lane data/tgl dir; tgl_ini outputs are also copied there (CLI --deploy-tgl-dir overrides)

jobs.name: REQUIRED unique job id
jobs.asset_class: OPTIONAL — mech | prop | building | vehicle | tree (default building; forwarded to ase_to_glb sidecar)

source.$comment: exactly ONE of: {ase+ini} (stock asset, extracted via tools/ase_to_glb.py) or {glb} (already-converted asset)
source.ini: path/to/stock.ini  (REQUIRED with ase; also the template for tgl_ini injection)

out.source_name: tgl_ini/glb_only: engine [Import] Source= base name; also the .glb filename
out.carry_textures: tgl_ini only, default true — re-attach stock texture URIs lost in the Blender round-trip
out.source_prefix: models_json: path prefix written into models.json sources (default data/model_overrides/cooked)
